artifact_schema.description: An integral general Weierstrass model and exactly 31 rational points certified independent modulo torsion.

curve.description: The five integral coefficients [a1, a2, a3, a4, a6], each as a canonical decimal string.

points.description: Exactly 31 affine rational points. Each point is [x, y]; every coordinate is a canonical integer string or a reduced fraction p/q with q > 1.

statement: Advance the public record for the Mordell-Weil rank of an elliptic curve over Q: submit an integral general Weierstrass equation y^2 + a1*x*y + a3*y = x^3 + a2*x^2 + a4*x + a6 and exactly 31 rational points that the pinned checker proves linearly independent modulo torsion. This succeeds the rank-at-least-30 challenge after curve #273 and 30 independent points were published by the ICARM Elliptic Curve Rank Leaderboard on 2026-08-20. The public rank-30 witness is retained at examples/elliptic-rank/artifacts/rank-30-record.json as a verifier baseline and does not satisfy this objective. Acceptance is deliberately narrower than the abstract rank-31 problem: the curve must have no rational 2-torsion, proved by a root-free reduction at a good prime p <= 10000, and the submitted points' Cremona-Brumer quadratic-character matrix must reach rank 31 over F_2 using good primes in that same bound. These sufficient conditions let every node check the lower bound using deterministic exact integer, rational, and finite-field arithmetic; no floating-point regulator, unproved rank claim, external service, or submitter-declared score is trusted. A solution proves only rank E(Q) >= 31. It does not prove the exact rank or that ranks over Q are unbounded. Source record: https://elliptic-rank.icarm.cloud/curve/273. Original rank-30 prompt: https://epoch.ai/frontiermath/open-problems/elliptic-curve-rank.
